inj.note: Howell suffered a right wrist injury during Sunday's overtime win against the Titans, and he will now be forced to miss at least four contests as a result. The defensive lineman has already undergone surgery, per reporters CLNSCincy.com, and in Howell's absence, Shemar Stewart will stand to see an increase in workload at defensive end.

news.h: Bengals defensive end Cashius Howell out indefinitely after wrist surgery
news.d: Bengals defensive end Cashius Howell will be out indefinitely after having surgery to repair his right wrist, which he injured in Cincinnati's win against the Titans on Sunday.
